learning_outcomes.text: Provide advanced knowledge, methods, and tools useful for the correct organization of mechanical design activities for new or revised products.
Be able to evaluate the technical and economical impact of decisions assumed during the designing phase.
Be able to reproduce the representation of a complex mechanical system.
Be able to define the relationship between the elements of a mechanical system.
Be able to calculate the constraints of a mechanical system.
Be able to draw the load diagrams of components.
Be able to compute the maximum tensile state of components.
Be able to select the most appropriate type of shaft-hub mechanical connection.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to product design: design set up, design develop and design manage.
The shaft-hub couplings: drive fit, taper fit
The gear design. The tooth stress: the bending and the pitting strength. The cylindrical gears straight-toothed and helical-toothed. The conical gears.
assessment_rules: Assessment is performed through a written test and an oral test. The written test lasts three hours, consists of three numerical exercises, and is passed with an overall grade of at least 18/30. The oral exam verifies theoretical topics and must be taken within the three sessions of the exam period in which the written exam was taken. The grade obtained in the written test can be refused only once.
